facts.fact: Ittan's wife's cough medicine is a brown jar of honey-and-root syrup in his writing case, which she takes only warmed; Devan promises to send it on and offers to write to her physicians himself.
facts.why: needed because the beat requires Ittan's cough-medicine request and Devan's offer to write to the physicians.

facts.fact: Ch 4 takes place on the second day after Rema's arrival: guardroom at midday while Rema and her escort are in the hall with the tally chest, the chamber scene that night, Unni's knock in the last dark hour before dawn of the third day.
facts.why: needed to place the moved execution before the hearing.

facts.fact: Rema's moved execution rests on a wartime charter clause for a prisoner whose keeping endangers the pass; her escort had Bhaskaran's night men stand down at the guardroom.
facts.why: the beat names a charter clause and an escort already in the court.

facts.fact: Devan knows Muthu brought or carried something to Ittan (the grey-sealed packet, ch 31) and does not name it to Muthu, to keep him at the gate through the hearing.
facts.why: needed to justify Devan's silence after Muthu's tell.
